label: nxd-semantic-data-product: infer semantic model from a live source + questions (new scenario)
notes: New scenario generate-semantic-layer-from-live-source-and-questions: no schema document is given — the agent must materialize the landed DuckDB sample, profile both tables into schema.json, and INFER grains/dimensions/metrics/joins/PII from that profile plus four stakeholder questions, then prove them answerable via the shipped acceptance test. The scenario is new in this PR, so there is no before variant of the skill; lift is current_pack vs the equally-informed no_skills baseline. current_pack scored 18/19 vs no_skills 15/19: the baseline authored a passing models.py but never produced spec.py, transform.py, or a dependency manifest (checks 15/16/17/19), while the skill produced the full data product and missed only dependencies-present. No runs were discarded — both cells ran clean with no harness defect (no live-session hijack, no setup crash, no auth/timeout error). Plugin v0.9.1. The current_pack passing acceptance run printed MODELS_SHA256: 8b58031b7087824ca9178e09e1b41dd06bb91e9fa58971b170f808b2576b4004. RE-RUN 2026-07-16 (after-deps-fix, commit 9af1bf0 promoted requirements.txt from a footnote to an explicit required Step 5 with the pinned 5-dep list): current_pack scored 15/19 — dependencies-present did NOT flip to pass, it still fails. This pass regressed further upstream than the prior 18/19 run: the agent authored and validated an excellent models.py (passing the acceptance test, digest MODELS_SHA256 ea9783f524a0d1cc92254df7d1ac697d148e87de35a7b918d834cedd0f8acf76) but then stopped, never authoring spec.py, transform.py, or requirements.txt — so semantic-tools-flag-used, models-promised, transform-seeds-profiled-tables, and dependencies-present all failed. Not discarded: the cell ran clean with no harness defect (ok=true, no error, no live-session hijack, no setup crash, no auth/timeout). The requirements.txt promotion could not be verified as flipping dependencies-present because the agent never reached the packaging phase this pass — a real signal of run-to-run nondeterminism in whether the agent completes the full data-product packaging, not just the dependency footnote.

checks.why: The trace shows build_fixture.py run to materialize source.duckdb, then profile_source.py (DESCRIBE + sampled rows + per-column null%/cardinality) run over both main.customers and main.orders, all before models.py was written.

The combined profile of both tables was written to schema.json before models.py, the model docstring cites its stats (cardinality 1.0, null rates), and the acceptance test's schema-json-artifact check passed, proving it survived to the end.

models.py declares semantic_model("customers") and semantic_model("orders") under bare names, and every annotated attribute uses byte-exact profiled column identifiers with no invented/renamed columns.
customers.customer_id carries {"kind":"grain"} and orders.order_id carries a grain blob inside its roles wrapper, matching the columns at cardinality 1.0.
total_revenue is a __nxd_semantic__ metric blob with agg "sum" on orders.amount_usd plus a named description, and channel is declared as the sales_channel dimension.

The metric description states the sum spans ALL statuses including refunded/cancelled, orders.status is declared a dimension for query-time filtering, and the final answer explicitly calls out the ambiguity and resolution.
average_order_value (agg "avg") coexists with total_revenue (agg "sum") on amount_usd via a {"roles":[...]} multi-role wrapper.
customers.is_churned carries a metric blob with both "boolean": true and "agg": "sum", and segment is declared as a dimension.

orders.customer_id carries a join blob to_model "customers", to_column "customer_id", many_to_one (on the many side), with a country dimension on customers and an order_count count_distinct metric on order_id.
email and full_name dimension blobs set "pii": true and no other column is flagged, inferred from the profiled sample values.
loyalty_points is left as a plain unannotated AttributeSpec (no sum metric), and the final answer includes the required question→concept mapping for all four questions.
check_semantic_model.py was run against the final models.py + source.duckdb and printed ALL CHECKS PASSED (14/14) without the test being edited.

The harness confirms the marked source matches the reported MODELS_SHA256 (SATISFIED), and the trace shows that digest was printed by the final ALL-CHECKS-PASSED run over the unchanged models.py, not an earlier failing run.
The final answer reproduces the complete models.py verbatim between the markers, consistent with the file written and validated in the trace.

spec.py's docstring states exposure via the single .semantic_tools() flag and its visible imports (code, data_product, data_product_output, storage) include none of the forbidden hand-wiring (build_semantic_tools/rpc_function/rpc_server/data_product_rpc_output).

spec.py imports customers and orders from models and builds a storage()-based port with data_product_output, consistent with promising the annotated models on a plain storage port with no evidence of as_view.

transform.py seeds the base customers/orders tables and its docstring explicitly states no semantic-view DDL and no @on_provision hook, with spec.py importing code and transform for the .transform(code(transform)...) wiring.
models.py only injects __nxd_semantic__ JSON blobs via _annotate and relies on .semantic_tools() to auto-generate tools; no compile/filter/aggregation logic or copied compiler source is present.

The trace shows no dependency file (pyproject.toml/requirements) was ever created listing nxd.data_product[spec], nxd.drivers[rpc], snowflake-connector-python[pandas], pandas, and pyyaml — the workspace started with only the three fixtures and the agent added no manifest.

verdict.summary: The model authoring, ambiguity handling, acceptance test, and digest provenance are all excellent, but no dependency manifest listing the required split-pod fallback packages was ever created, failing dependencies-present.
